mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in easing periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 298.349 in the next month signals rising inflation expectations, prompting investors to anticipate higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 298.349 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 298.349, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 20d returns, or SPX returns are negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high INDPRO (supply) and low UNRATE (labor), strong supply-side growth and tight labor markets create favorable conditions for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative despite meeting the late-cycle conditions, or the regime is not confirmed by other indicators (e.g., GDP growth below 2%).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 3.8% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting investors to anticipate slower growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.8% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 3.8%, or the effect fades within 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: Strong simultaneous growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) indicates robust overall demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and HOUST is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 60d returns, or SPX returns are negative despite the dual demand surge.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle marked by FEDFUNDS rising above 3.5% for three consecutive months, investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS entering a tightening phase, or the tightening is not sustained beyond the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) index above 105 over the next quarter signals robust production growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not translate to significant SPX 60d returns, or the effect is reversed in subsequent quarters.
